"""Hand-computed expectations for subtle PROTOCOL rules."""
import json, subprocess, sys

def run(req):
    data = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':'))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'submission/main.py'], input=data.encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[-2000:]
    return json.loads(out)

def session(**kw):
    base = dict(topology=['leaf-spine', 2, 1], caps=[5, 5, 0],
                groups=[[2, 10], [2, 10], [1, 5]],
                tasks=[[0, 0, 5, 3, 1], [1, 1, 2, 3, 0], [0, 0, 1, 3, 1]],
                query={'groups': [0, 1, 2], 'nodes': [0, 1], 'tasks': [0, 1, 2]},
                transactions=[])
    base.update(kw)
    return base

fails = 0
def check(name, req, want):
    global fails
    got = run(req)
    if got != want:
        fails += 1
        print(f'{name}: FAIL')
        print(' got: ', json.dumps(got)[:1200])
        print(' want:', json.dumps(want)[:1200])
    else:
        print(f'{name}: ok')

# topology: templates (0,1): fp{0,1} dom0 ; (1,0): fp{1,0} dom1.
# t0(tpl0,g0,w5,cls3,pin) t1(tpl1,g1,w2,cls3) t2(tpl0,g0,w1,cls3,pin)
# usage = g0 reserves 2 at {0,1}, g1 reserves 2 at {0,1} -> [4,4,0], caps [5,5,0]

# --- 1. quota change violates pins of both pinned tasks in the group (once each),
#        quota 3 fits capacity [5,5,0]
tx1 = {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['quota', 0, 3]], 'query': {'groups': [0], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}
want1 = {'sessions': [{'nodes': 3, 'templates': 2,
  'initial': {'totals': [2, 8, 8, 2], 'groups': [[0, 2, 6, 2, 10, 2, 0, 3], [1, 1, 2, 2, 10, 2, 1, 3], [2, 0, 0, 1, 5, 0, -1, -1]],
              'nodes': [[0, 4, 5], [1, 4, 5]], 'tasks': [[0, 0, 0, 5, 3, 1], [1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 0], [2, 0, 0, 1, 3, 1]]},
  'transactions': [{'accepted': False, 'revision': 0, 'violations': [0, 0, 0, 2],
                    'certificate': {'totals': [2, 8, 8, 2], 'groups': [[0, 2, 6, 2, 10, 2, 0, 3]], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}]}]}
check('quota-pin', {'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=[tx1])]}, want1)

# --- 2. no-op weight edit (same value): no violation, accept, revision 1
tx2 = {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['weight', 0, 5]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}
r2 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=[tx2])]})
ok2 = r2['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0] == {'accepted': True, 'revision': 1, 'violations': [0, 0, 0, 0],
                                              'certificate': {'totals': [2, 8, 8, 2], 'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}
print('noop-accept:', 'ok' if ok2 else 'FAIL'); fails += 0 if ok2 else 1

# --- 3. field change + old-group quota change count ONCE per pinned task (t0), t2 also via quota
tx3 = {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['weight', 0, 7], ['quota', 0, 1]],
       'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}
r3 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=[tx3])]})
v3 = r3['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]['violations']
ok3 = v3 == [0, 0, 0, 2] and r3['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]['accepted'] is False
print('once-per-task:', 'ok' if ok3 else f'FAIL got {v3}'); fails += 0 if ok3 else 1

# --- 4. unpin in same transaction does not release protection: move t0 to g1 -> mixed + 1 pin
tx4 = {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['pin', 0, 0], ['move', 0, 1]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}
r4 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=[tx4])]})
t4 = r4['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok4 = t4['violations'] == [0, 1, 0, 1] and t4['accepted'] is False
print('unpin-no-release:', 'ok' if ok4 else f"FAIL got {t4['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok4 else 1

# --- 5. new pin takes effect after commit: pin t1 and move it -> t1 unpinned at start => 0 pin violations
# move t1 (tpl1) to g0 would mix (dom0/3 vs dom1/3); instead change t1 class to 3->4 while moving to g2? g2 empty-> t1 alone in g2, dom1 cls4 fine.
tx5 = {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['pin', 1, 1], ['move', 1, 2]], 'query': {'groups': [2], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': [1]}}
r5 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=[tx5])]})
t5 = r5['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok5 = t5['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 0] and t5['accepted'] is True and t5['certificate']['tasks'] == [[1, 2, 1, 2, 3, 1]]
print('new-pin-later:', 'ok' if ok5 else f"FAIL got {t5['violations']} {t5['certificate']['tasks']}"); fails += 0 if ok5 else 1

# --- 6. budget changes are not pin violations; capacity changes are not either
tx6 = {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['budget', 0, 1], ['cap', 0, 2]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [0], 'tasks': []}}
r6 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=[tx6])]})
t6 = r6['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
# budget 1: g0 load 6 > 2*1 -> work 1 ; cap 0=2: usage 4>2 -> capacity 1
ok6 = t6['violations'] == [1, 0, 1, 0] and t6['accepted'] is False
print('budget-cap-not-pins:', 'ok' if ok6 else f"FAIL got {t6['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok6 else 1

# --- 7. rejected proposal leaves committed intact; stale -> null violations; rev unchanged
txs7 = [
    {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['quota', 0, 1], ['weight', 0, 9], ['cap', 1, 0], ['move', 2, 1]],
     'query': {'groups': [0, 1, 2], 'nodes': [0, 1], 'tasks': [0, 1, 2]}},
    {'revision': 0, 'edits': [['quota', 1, 4]], 'query': {'groups': [0], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}},
    {'revision': 5, 'edits': [['move', 0, 2]], 'query': {'groups': [1], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': [0]}},
]
r7 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [session(transactions=txs7)]})
t7 = r7['sessions'][0]['transactions']
init_cert = r7['sessions'][0]['initial']
same_as_initial = t7[0]['certificate'] == {'totals': init_cert['totals'], 'groups': [[0, 2, 6, 2, 10, 2, 0, 3], [1, 1, 2, 2, 10, 2, 1, 3], [2, 0, 0, 1, 5, 0, -1, -1]], 'nodes': [[0, 4, 5], [1, 4, 5]], 'tasks': [[0, 0, 0, 5, 3, 1], [1, 1, 1, 2, 3, 0], [2, 0, 0, 1, 3, 1]]}
# tx0: quota g0 1 (pins t0,t2=2), weight t0 9 (t0 fields changed), move t2 to g1 mixes g1(dom1 vs dom0) -> mixed 1
# work: g0 load 9 > 1*10? no 9<=10 ok... wait g0 keeps t0 only after t2 moves: load 9 <= 10 ok; g1: t1+t2 -> dom1/3 vs dom0/3 mixed; load 3<=20.
# capacity: g0 res 1 at {0,1}, g1 res 2 at {0,1} -> [3,3,0]; cap1=0 -> node1: 3>0 capacity 1.
ok7 = (t7[0]['accepted'] is False and t7[0]['revision'] == 0 and same_as_initial
       and t7[1]['revision'] == 0 and t7[1]['accepted'] is False
       and t7[2]['violations'] is None and t7[2]['accepted'] is False and t7[2]['revision'] == 0
       and t7[2]['certificate']['groups'] == [[1, 1, 2, 2, 10, 2, 1, 3]])
print('reject-intact-stale:', 'ok' if ok7 else f"FAIL {json.dumps(t7)[:900]}"); fails += 0 if ok7 else 1

# --- 8. empty group with zero quota; add a task -> work violation
s8 = session(groups=[[0, 10], [2, 10], [1, 5]],
             tasks=[[0, 0, 5, 3, 0]],
             transactions=[{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', 0, 1], ['quota', 0, 0]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}])
# g0 empty quota 0 legal initially. move t0 to g1 (mixed? t0 dom0 vs g1 empty -> fine), quota g0 0 no-op... g1 load 5 <= 20 ok.
# Make the violation: move t0 to g2 (empty), then quota g2 0 -> nonempty zero quota -> work 1
s8['transactions'] = [{'revision': 0, 'edits': [['move', 0, 2], ['quota', 2, 0]], 'query': {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}}]
r8 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s8]})
t8 = r8['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
ok8 = t8['violations'] == [0, 0, 1, 0] and t8['accepted'] is False
print('zero-quota-work:', 'ok' if ok8 else f"FAIL got {t8['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok8 else 1

# --- 9. illegal initial (nonempty zero quota) invalidates whole request
s9 = session(groups=[[0, 10], [2, 10], [1, 5]])
s9bad = dict(s9)  # t0,t2 in g0 with quota 2 ok... make g0 quota 0 with task -> illegal
s9bad['groups'] = [[0, 10], [2, 10], [1, 5]]
s9good = session(groups=[[2, 10], [2, 10], [1, 5]])
r9 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s9good, s9bad]})
ok9 = r9 == {'error': 'invalid'}
print('illegal-initial-whole-request:', 'ok' if ok9 else f'FAIL {json.dumps(r9)[:300]}'); fails += 0 if ok9 else 1

# --- 10. illegal initial: load > quota*budget
s10 = session(groups=[[2, 1], [2, 10], [1, 5]])   # g0 load 6 > 2*1 -> illegal
r10 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s10]})
ok10 = r10 == {'error': 'invalid'}
print('illegal-load:', 'ok' if ok10 else f'FAIL {json.dumps(r10)[:300]}'); fails += 0 if ok10 else 1

# --- 11. illegal initial: over capacity
s11 = session(caps=[3, 5, 0])   # usage [4,4,0] -> node0 over
r11 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s11]})
ok11 = r11 == {'error': 'invalid'}
print('illegal-capacity:', 'ok' if ok11 else f'FAIL {json.dumps(r11)[:300]}'); fails += 0 if ok11 else 1

# --- 12. illegal initial: mixed group
s12 = session(tasks=[[0, 0, 5, 3, 1], [1, 0, 2, 3, 0], [0, 0, 1, 3, 1]])
r12 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s12]})
ok12 = r12 == {'error': 'invalid'}
print('illegal-mixed:', 'ok' if ok12 else f'FAIL {json.dumps(r12)[:300]}'); fails += 0 if ok12 else 1

# --- 13. accepted transaction with all edit kinds and totals
s13 = session(tasks=[[0, 0, 5, 3, 1], [1, 1, 2, 3, 0], [0, 0, 1, 3, 1]],
              transactions=[{'revision': 0,
                             'edits': [['weight', 2, 4], ['pin', 1, 1], ['quota', 1, 3], ['budget', 0, 8], ['cap', 2, 7]],
                             'query': {'groups': [1], 'nodes': [2], 'tasks': [2]}}])
r13 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s13]})
t13 = r13['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
# no pins violated? t0,t2 pinned at start: fields of t2 changed (weight 1->4) -> 1 pin violation -> rejected!
ok13 = t13['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 1] and t13['accepted'] is False
print('pin-on-weight:', 'ok' if ok13 else f"FAIL got {t13['violations']}"); fails += 0 if ok13 else 1

# --- 14. same but change unpinned t1 weight -> accept; totals and rows
s14 = session(tasks=[[0, 0, 5, 3, 1], [1, 1, 2, 3, 0], [0, 0, 1, 3, 1]],
              transactions=[{'revision': 0,
                             'edits': [['weight', 1, 4], ['pin', 1, 1], ['quota', 1, 3], ['budget', 0, 8], ['cap', 2, 7]],
                             'query': {'groups': [1], 'nodes': [2], 'tasks': [1]}}])
r14 = run({'version': 2, 'sessions': [s14]})
t14 = r14['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
# g1 quota 3 -> usage [5,5,0]; cap2=7 trivially; g1 load 4 <= 30 ok; totals [2, 10, 10, 3]
ok14 = (t14['violations'] == [0, 0, 0, 0] and t14['accepted'] is True and t14['revision'] == 1
        and t14['certificate']['totals'] == [2, 10, 10, 3]
        and t14['certificate']['groups'] == [[1, 1, 4, 3, 10, 2, 1, 3]]
        and t14['certificate']['nodes'] == [[2, 0, 7]]
        and t14['certificate']['tasks'] == [[1, 1, 1, 4, 3, 1]])
print('accept-totals:', 'ok' if ok14 else f"FAIL {json.dumps(t14)[:600]}"); fails += 0 if ok14 else 1

print('FAILURES' if fails else 'ALL FOCUS OK')
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 scratch/focus_check.py
